title: Principal Details Object
description: Schema for validating the Principal Details column JSON object structure in FOCUS datasets

PrincipalName.description: Readable display name for the principal identified by Principal ID

PrincipalEmail.description: Email address associated with the principal identified by Principal ID

PrincipalType.description: The kind of principal identified by Principal ID (e.g., User, Service Account, Application)

Intermediates.description: Identities through which the request passed before reaching the principal identified by Principal ID, ordered from the identity nearest the service provider boundary to the identity nearest that principal

PrincipalType.description: The kind of intermediate identity (e.g., API Key, Session, Delegated Role)

PrincipalName.description: Readable display name for the intermediate identity

^x_[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$.description: Custom data generator-defined properties prefixed with x_ in PascalCase format
Custom data generator-defined top-level properties prefixed with x_ in PascalCase format
